verdict.rationale: Orrick publishes a free Convertible Note Financing Term Sheet Creator among 50+ Tech Studio forms and generators. It also states a venture practice covering seed-stage financings (Germany, France, and nearly 3,000 venture financings globally), and the community praises its free startup forms and term sheet generator. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly mentions SAFEs or pre-seed-specific explainers. Missing for 10: explicit SAFE forms or explainers, published convertible-instrument explainer content, a stated pre-seed-specific practice, and independent corroboration of convertible or SAFE deal work.
